maxOrderValue.title: Largest cash-on-delivery order
maxOrderValue.description: In minor units of your currency (for example cents). Larger orders must be paid another way. 0 = no limit.

advanceAmount.title: Advance (fixed amount)
advanceAmount.description: Paid through Payments before a cash-on-delivery order is confirmed, in minor units. Wins over the percent. 0 = none.

advancePercent.title: Advance (percent of the total)
advancePercent.description: Used when there is no fixed advance, rounded up. 0 = none.

rtoThreshold.title: Returned parcels before a customer is flagged
rtoThreshold.description: A customer with at least this many parcels returned to you is flagged. 0 = never.

rtoRequireAdvance.title: Flagged customers pay an advance
rtoRequireAdvance.description: Flagged customers may use cash on delivery only with the advance; without an advance set they must pay another way.

startStatus.title: Cash-on-delivery orders start
startStatus.description: awaiting_confirmation: staff confirm each order. open: confirmed as soon as it is placed.

atPickup.title: Cash on delivery at pickup too
atPickup.description: Shoppers who pick up their order may also choose to pay cash when they collect it.

feePercent.title: Cash handling fee (%)
feePercent.description: Added to cash-on-delivery orders (shown as Cash handling). 0 = none.

feeBase.title: Cash handling fee is a percent of
feeBase.description: order_total: the order total (after points, with delivery and tax). goods_after_discounts: the goods after deals and the role discount, before points, delivery and tax.

paidOnDelivery.title: Paid when delivered
paidOnDelivery.description: On: delivering a cash-on-delivery order marks it paid. Off: staff record the cash in the order's payments.

advanceVia.title: The advance is paid
advanceVia.description: payments: through Payments before the order is confirmed. manual: by bank transfer; staff record it in the order's payments.
